title: Main Reasons for Rejection of Applications for HDB Rental Flats
what_it_is: Main Reasons for Rejection of Applications for HDB Rental Flats

sections.label: HDB rental flat rejections and supply
sections.summary: Rejections are commonly due to ability to buy, family support or citizenship, and HDB has about 60,000 rental flats with 3,000 under construction.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The most common reasons for rejecting requests for HDB public rental flats are that applicants have the ability to buy a flat, have family support, or are unable to meet the citizenship requirement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For households who do not meet the eligibility criteria, HDB exercises flexibility based on their individual needs and circumstances.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: On the Member's second question, there are about 60,000 existing HDB rental flats, with another 3,000 units under construction.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB will continue to monitor the net demand for rental flats, as more rental families have become homeowners, and make adjustments to our rental flat supply as required.

sections.label: Non-citizen parents and Joint Single Scheme
sections.summary: HDB takes a child-centric approach for non-citizen parents with a citizen child, and helps Joint Single Scheme applicants find a co-renter.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For non-citizen parents with a Singapore Citizen child, we will adopt a child-centric approach.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, in such cases, the Member could reflect the case to HDB and HDB will take a child-centric approach and make sure that where the applicant has no other options for housing, they will make sure that accommodation is provided for the child.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: For the Joint Single Scheme, for those unable to find an appropriate, related family member or friend to stay with them, but still prefer to stay alone, what options are available to them?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But where such cases are surfaced to us, HDB will try its very best to find a suitable person to co-rent with the applicant.
